rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: GRASP exposes 47 tools for AI agents to analyze codebases through dependency graphs, circular dependency detection, architecture mapping, security scanning, refactoring suggestions, test coverage analysis, and PR impact analysis. The server enables AI coding assistants to deeply understand codebase structure and relationships rather than working from surface-level pattern matching.
